name: outage
description: Three hostiles while nodes lose their link. F2's link is cut from 20 to 65 s (45 s: long enough to be called isolated), GS2's messages are delayed by 4 s from 70 to 85 s, and F4 goes down for good at 100 s. Store-and-forward is on: nodes keep what C2 has not acknowledged and resend it once the link is back. Faults apply in Realistic mode only.
